text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Green Suma - (built 1981) 22,172 dwt sold to Taiwanese buyers for $5 million.
Balsa 39 - (built 1986) 6,587 dwt sold to Hong Kong buyers for $3.3 million.
TANKERS - Sunshine - (built 1985) sold to free flag buyers for $16.75 million on subjects.
Chemical Symphony - (built 19830 sold to European buyers for $8 million.
Golden Kyosei - (built 1981) 6,162 dwt sold to German buyers for $6.25 million.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Flag Leader - (built 1972) 39,889 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $173 per ldt.
Zim Elat - (built 1973) 31,846 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $188 per ldt.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
